recentItems.title: ‘Can’t Breathe’: Arunachal Erupts| Tear Gas, Building Torched, Anti-Dam Fury Turns Violent| Watch
recentItems.description:
#arunachalpradesh #pasighat #siangdam #antidamprotest #siangproject #sump #nhpc #policestation #arunachalnews #northeastindia #damprotest #siangriver #aditribe #indigenousrights #pemakhandu #environmentalprotest #indiabreakingnews #indi news #breakingnews #latestnews #viralvideo #protestviolence 

Violent protests against the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project rocked Pasighat in Arunachal Pradesh, with an NHPC office and police station allegedly torched and the residences of three political leaders vandalised. Chief Minister Pema Khandu condemned the violence and urged peace, while anti-dam groups continued demanding the project's cancellation.

recentItems.title: Anant Singh's Sharp Reply To JD(U) After Expulsion, 'Strongman' Backed Prashant Kishor? Paswan Says
recentItems.description:
Expelled JD(U) MLA and Mokama strongman Anant Singh has hit back at the party leadership, predicting the party will win just 10-12 seats in the next Bihar Assembly elections. Singh hinted at launching his own political outfit, defended his equation with Nitish Kumar and faced criticism over alleged anti-party activities.
